Kleavor

Bug Rock

Galar · Generation 8

Kleavor is a Bug/Rock-type Axe Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 89 kg. It evolves from Scyther. Its highest base stat is Attack (135), with a base stat total of 500.
